prompts: Original Japanese top-down pixel RPG asset visually inspired by Pokemon FireRed's overworld. Orthographic three-quarter TOP-DOWN RPG angle, front facing directly down to player, no isometric diamond or perspective convergence. Chunky deliberate pixels, crisp edges, restrained 24-color palette, dark colored outlines, sun from upper left, simple 3-shade clusters. Transparent background, no floor, no shadow beyond footprint, no text or logos. Readable when scaled down into a 16px-grid game. Match the attached reference sprites exactly in palette, outline and pixel density. pixel-art game sprite of the real storefront; not resembling any Nintendo / Game Freak / Pokémon asset. Override the generic no-text clause: required accurate brand signage. ONE isolated Yoshinoya Tokyo counter shop, orange fascia with large black 吉野家 wordmark and small white bowl logo, cream walls, brown trim, glass entrance on right, counter and stools visible on left. Broad grey flat roof visible from above, front faces straight down. Match palette, outline weight, pixel density and three-quarter top-down angle of attached reference sprites exactly. Logical 96×80 pixel sprite, chunky 1 logical pixel clusters, no tiny details. Render at least 1024 pixels, transparent background, no ground, no people. Entire building fits canvas.
notes: Real brand storefront by art-direction decision (#85); not affiliated. Anchors are zero-based runtime pixel coordinates from top-left. Door marks the threshold; foot marks the bottom-centre sorting point. collisionTiles is the 16px-grid ground footprint of the facade (roof overhang and transparent padding are not collision). Atlas is the artist-finished exact-size sprite: alpha>=128 crop, nearest-neighbour fit, quantized to <=31 colours + transparent, hard alpha. Map owner places a walkable portal in front of the door. Art reviewed at 1x and 3x/6x.
